description: Runs the project's gdUnit4 suites and answers with every case that did not pass. Needs gdUnit4 under addons/gdUnit4. It first updates .godot's class list and imports what is behind. The run's user:// is its own and is deleted after, but on macOS it is the player's. A suite needing a window shows one on Linux and macOS.

failFast.description: Stop each suite at its first failing case. Default false.

ignore.description: Suites, cases or rows to leave out: "suite", "suite:test", or "suite:test:N" for row N, from 0. suite is the file name without .gd, so a bare test name leaves out nothing.

path.description: A test directory or suite file, or a list of them. Default tests and test. "tests/suite.gd:test_name" runs one case.

printed.description: Also answer with the lines the run printed that contain this, ignoring case, under printed.

tests.description: Run only these cases of the suites under path: "test_name", or "suite:test_name" with suite the file name without .gd.

timeoutMs.description: How long the run may take before it is killed, counted from the engine starting. Default 600000.

name: project_test
title: Run tests
